verdict.rationale: Formant provides a Cloud Python SDK explicitly for querying/exporting telemetry data and an Admin/Agent API for programmatic access, which enables some data portability, but there is no documentation of exporting *all* account data, no mention of open/standard file formats (CSV/JSON/Parquet), and no explicit 'leave with your data' guarantee or account-closure export flow. missing for 10: explicit full-account data export scope, named open export formats, and any statement about portability/exit guarantees.
